correctness.rationale: Parity of σ(m)=m+S forbids even S because two odd squares in a five block cannot differ by 2; odd S forces all even block terms to be squares or twice-squares, eliminating even N by three even terms. For odd N the two even terms N+1,N+3 are opposite square types, producing a²−2b²=−2 or b²−2a²=2, and the divisor identities via σ(2b²)=3σ(b²) for odd b. Descent/multiplication by 3+2√2 parametrizes both Pell equations and geometric growth yields O(log X) candidate starts. Independently regenerated exactly 25 candidates in EACH Pell family with N<10^38, factored all a,b with sympy.factorint, reconstructed prime-power products and exact σ values; all 50 identities have NONZERO residual (minimum absolute residual 2). Largest coordinate 9733505285848307044<2^64. Thus no five-term run starts at 1<=N<10^38; no assertion beyond.
residual_risks: The finite cutoff is N<10^38; no global nonexistence beyond this cutoff is claimed.
